description: Fetches the caption transcript of one YouTube video (uploaded or auto-generated captions), as plain text with the caption language. Use it to read, quote or summarise what is said in a YouTube video. Use job_transcribe instead for a video with no captions (download the media to a direct link first) or audio outside YouTube. Use job_youtube_comments instead for what viewers say about the video. Cost: $0.0033 per transcript, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most transcripts to return and pay for (default 1, at most 1); the run stops there.

video_url.description: The video's URL: youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtube.com/shorts/... or youtu.be/... (11-character video id).

name: job_youtube_transcript

items.description: {videoId, url, status (ok; failed = captions off or video unavailable, free), language, isGenerated, durationSeconds, text}

status.description: ok; failed = captions off or video unavailable, free

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)

title: YouTube video transcript (captions)
